parent.rule: Parent raw role must strictly equal 'SIMULATION' without strip or case normalization.

child.rule: Child raw role must strictly equal 'READ_ONLY' without strip or case normalization.

config_id_matching.rule: configId must be non-blank and match descriptor expectedConfigId under both raw ordinal string comparison and snapshot-trimmed ordinal comparison.

descriptor_sha256.rule: Descriptor expectedConfigSha256 must be strictly 64 ASCII hex characters without padding or trimming.

executable_sha256.rule: Executable SHA256 must be trimmed 64 ASCII hex characters.

path_equality.rule: Declared Windows path equality verified under DOS comparison domain (normcase(abspath(p)).rstrip('\/')).

path_ancestry_verification.rule: Reusable whole-ancestry guard checks all existing ancestor directories via os.lstat without following symlinks/junctions; rejects reparse points (0x400), invalid control chars, ADS colons, reserved DOS devices, and trailing dots/spaces; fails closed on any inspection error.

userdata_isolation.rule: workerUserDataDirectory and validatorUserDataDirectory must be distinct when normalized.

content_profile_fingerprint.rule: expectedContentProfileFingerprint must be a non-blank string (not constrained to 64 hex characters).

package_policy_declaration.rule: Object containing schemaVersion, policyId, policyRevision, and admittedPackageIds; policyRevision admits string or integer with explicit boolean exclusion (not isinstance(val, bool)); admittedPackageIds retains order; no constant policy schema or package uniqueness mandated.

timestamp_format.rule: issuedAtUtc must be a valid Gregorian UTC ISO 8601 string (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss[.1..7digits]Z) with calendar/time validity and exact raw fractional digits preserved without roundoff to 6 digits.

cli_invocation.rule: Strict --spec <absoluteSpecPath> CLI invocation with exact argc 3; closed 6 required keys (operatorPairId, parentDeclaration, childDeclaration, parentConfigPath, childConfigPath, outputDir) + optional bundleFilename fixed to 'operator_startup_pair.json'. Inline mode rejected fail-closed.
